Invalid weight leaves the previous face's canvas font in place

items.claim: Within-family chain misses a family whose faces are all far from the request, e.g. only a 300, only a 700, or only an italic face
An outline-only default family is never substituted
`cssFontFamily` returns the family unquoted when the DOM uses it as it stands
Resolving a canvas font with no canvas throws
Under `'none'`, a `registerCanvasFont` family gets no per-code-point escalation, and the warning says to call `registerCanvasFont`
Text lays out in a landed stand-in while the variant the chain would pick is still fetching
`warmFonts(['Brand'])` resolves when that family's loads have already failed
`warmFonts` with a `FontRequest` doesn't warm the substitute for a registered family whose chain finds no face
items.note: (the chain now always lands within a family that has a face) and ce187b68ee (`variantLoads` follows the resolver's pick and falls through to the substitute for a family with no landed face)

items.claim: Font picker lists a lazy variant at once but an eager one only after it lands
A replaced or superseded atlas `ImageBitmap` is never closed
Resolving a landed face wakes every other lazily declared variant of its family
A multi-page BMFont atlas draws its page-1+ glyphs from page 0's image
items.note: The fix refuses such an atlas, naming the glyph. That is a strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: whether the registry should take one URL per page is open.

items.claim: Chain serves nothing for an italic-only family, or one whose only faces are in the other weight bucket
items.note: duplicate of the first finding, fixed 9cedc2b4eb

items.claim: `warmFonts` does not warm the substitute a registered family falls back to
items.note: duplicate of the `FontRequest` finding, fixed 9cedc2b4eb + ce187b68ee

items.claim: A canvas glyph that found no room right after an emptying stays invisible until a new glyph is asked for
items.note: Asking for it again once the pages settle bakes it again. That retry happens at most once until the text changes, so text needing more than the pages hold doesn't empty them every frame.
